title: DMSO and Compound Stock Solution Addition - Part 2
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Transfer DMSO to columns 2‑12
steps.instruction: Using the same tips, dispense 2.4 µL × n of DMSO from the DMSO reservoir into columns 2 through 12 of Dilution Plate DMSO 1‑1.

steps.title: Add DMSO to second plate wells
steps.instruction: Dispense 2.4 µL × n of DMSO from the reservoir into every well of Dilution Plate DMSO 1‑2, then discard the tips.

steps.title: Add compound stock to first plate
steps.instruction: With retained tips, transfer 7.2 µL × n of compound stock from column 1 of the Compound Stocks plate to column 1 of Dilution Plate DMSO 1‑1.

steps.title: Serially dilute DMSO in first plate
steps.instruction: Using the same tips, transfer 4.8 µL × n from column 1 to column 2 of Dilution Plate DMSO 1‑1, mix; repeat the transfer‑mix sequence from column 2→3, 3→4, …, up to column 10→11 (skip column 12), keeping the tips throughout.

steps.title: Transfer final DMSO sample to second plate
steps.instruction: With the same tips, move 4.8 µL × n from column 11 of Dilution Plate DMSO 1‑1 to column 1 of Dilution Plate DMSO 1‑2 and mix, keeping the tips.

steps.title: Serially dilute DMSO in second plate
steps.instruction: Using the retained tips, transfer 4.8 µL × n from column 1 to column 2 of Dilution Plate DMSO 1‑2, mix; repeat the transfer‑mix sequence through columns 2→3, 3→4, …, up to column 10→11 (skip column 12), then discard the tips.
